Visily vs Figma: similarities and differences

Similarities

Visily and Figma share several core similarities, making them both great options for mocking up designs and creating prototypes.

First, both tools harness AI to accelerate the design process. Visily leverages AI to generate designs from screenshots, create diagrams from text, suggest images, fill content, and more. Meanwhile, Figma incorporates AI within its FigJam feature to assist in designing diagrams, boards, timelines, and plans efficiently.

A few other key similarities:
Both are web-based (web app).
Both have a free plan (but with varying functions for each).
Both are a collaborative design tool.

Differences

While Visily and Figma share some similarities, there are some notable differences that set the tools apart.

Visily was created with non-designers in mind and is geared to help anyone visualize and design products fast. Its intuitive drag-and-drop interface, along with cutting-edge AI features, simplifies the creation of wireframes, mockups, prototypes, diagrams, designs, and more.

Figma, on the other hand, caters more to experienced designers, thanked to its advanced capabilities, such as scalable vector graphics. Figma has a steeper learning curve and is not as straightforward for beginners.

A standout advantage of Visily is its comprehensive features, including a built-in diagram tool that facilitates the creation of sitemaps, user flows, journey maps, and more to visualize digital product ideas. Additionally, the platform’s extensive library is packed with templates, icons, illustrations, and other assets, all easily draggable and droppable, making it highly accessible and user-friendly for both designers and non-designers alike.

Visily also uses more advanced AI capabilities. Visily’s AI goes beyond just generating designs. You can also use it to generate your logical diagram, mockups and prototypes.

Which is best for what?

Visily

Figma

Visily excels at accelerating the entire design process with its latest AI update. The platform empowers anyone, from product managers to non-designers, to transform ideas into polished designs more seamlessly than ever before. With intuitive design tools powered by smarter AI assistance, Visily makes it easy to move from concept to visualization instantly, helping teams work faster and collaborate more effectively.

The platform includes a library of over 1,500 templates spanning more than 40 categories. From landing pages and app interfaces to social media assets and dashboards, these templates give you a solid starting point for almost any type of design. Each one is easy to adjust and customize, so you can quickly shape it into something that fits your project without needing to start from scratch.

Visily’s intuitive drag-and-drop editor has a gentle learning curve compared to Figma’s steeper one.

Visily also offers onboarding, helpful product articles, and tutorials to guide new users.

Figma excels at creating advanced, interactive prototypes. Its prototyping tool help designers to link artboards together and create complex user flows with conditional logic.

Figma’s vector-based tools enable the creation of detailed, high-fidelity interfaces with customizable components and interactive elements like hover states. While Figma doesn’t come with a pre-built library, it allows designers in crafting their own design systems, complete with personalized libraries of colors, fonts, and shadows.

Visily is the best alternative to Figma
for non-designers

Figma's rich array of tools and advanced features offers extensive functionality, which may take some time for new users, particularly non-designers, to fully explore and utilize comfortably.

Visily is a free alternative to Figma. It helps non-designers create designs easily. Its intuitive tools and simple interface make wireframing and mocking up ideas quick and hassle-free. Freedom to design, minus the headaches.

Figma’s advanced features cater specifically to skilled designers, allowing for the creation of detailed wireframes and complex design tasks. While this specialization enhances design capabilities, it also means that the platform is best utilized by those with expertise, as it may present a steep learning curve for non-designer stakeholders

Visily's collaborative design tools let stakeholders co-design in real time (no need for design expertise), on one same canvas.

To access the full range of Figma's capabilities, users must explore and familiarize with various plugins. This process may require some learning.

Visily bakes in all the tools non-designers need into one intuitive interface — no plugins required.

Visily’s collaborative design tools let stakeholders co-design in real time (no need for design expertise). You can instantly share wireframes and mockups with a simple link, no rebuilding required.

Build prototypes fast

Visily is an intuitive ideation, wireframing, and prototyping tool, perfect for the early stages of product design. Once you have hashed out the initial concepts and flows in Visily, simply export your wireframes and prototypes into Figma for pixel-perfect designs.

Simply, better together

Introducing Visily’s Figma Plug-in: a powerful combination that maximizes the strengths of both tools. Enjoy Visily’s speed and flexibility for rapid ideation, paired with Figma’s advanced design features for precision and refinement.
Truly, a match made in design heaven!
